actionGroups.description: List of action-groups for the action.

actionSecurityLevel.description: The minimum securityLevel (user must have same or lower value) of the target action.

userSecurityLevel.description: The securityLevel of the user trying to execute the action.

allowedPermission.description:
Arry of {@link Permission} that grant access the target action. To know all permissions that a User have, please refer to
{@link User.allPermissions}.

The key stands for the source of permission, could come from {@link Role} or {@link PageGroup}.

deniedPermissions.description:
Arry of {@link Permission} that deny access the target action. To know all permissions that a User have, please refer to
{@link User.allPermissions}.

The key stands for the source of permission, could come from {@link Role} or {@link PageGroup}.

roles.description:
Arry of Roles that can be applied to the target action. To know all roles that a User have, please refer to
{@link User.allRoles}.

pageGroups.description: Arry of {@link PageGroup} that grant permission to access the target action.

authorized.description:
If {@link #username} field is populated, authorized means if the {@link username} is authorized to do
{@link #typename}.{@link #action}

title:
Authorization check result for the given action in a env/app. If {@link #username} is populated, {@link #allowedRoles},
, {@link #deniedRoles}, {@link #groups} and {@link #authorized} are the ones that {@link #username} has and can be applied
to the target action {@link #env}.{@link #action} in {@link #Env} {@link #App}, then {@link #authorized} represents if
the {@link username} has granted permission to the action or not.

If {@link username} field is not populated, then all the fields represents all the authorization information applied
to the target action. i.e (@link #allowedRoles) would have all the roles that have permission to the target action
{@link #env}.{@link #action} in {@link #env} {@link #app}.
name: ActionAuthorizationInfo
